definitions.explanation: A box or slot where incoming mail is received at a residence.

examples.japanese: {郵便受|ゆうびんう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There was a letter in the mailbox.

examples.japanese: {郵便受|ゆうびんう}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{郵便受|ゆうびんう}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。

⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{郵便受|ゆうびんう}け⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}す→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Taking the newspaper out of the mailbox every morning is part of my daily routine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、{郵便受|ゆうびんう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦チラシ→チラシ：23406_chirashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: After being away for a week on a trip, there were lots of flyers stuffed in the mailbox.

notes:
{郵便受|ゆうびんう}け is a mailbox for receiving incoming mail, not for sending.

FORMS:
⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧ (mail) + {受|う}け (receiving) = mail receiver

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {郵便受|ゆうびんう}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the mailbox
- {郵便受|ゆうびんう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to arrive in the mailbox
- {郵便受|ゆうびんう}け⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}す→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧: to take out from the mailbox

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {郵便受|ゆうびんう}け: receiving mailbox (at home)
- ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧ / ⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧: public mailbox (for sending)

Note: ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧ is often used casually to mean either type of mailbox. In apartments, mailboxes are typically located in the entrance lobby (⟦エントランス→エントランス：08938_entoransu⟧).
